verdict.rationale: Runloop's core product is API/CLI-driven Devbox provisioning, execution, and teardown (via snapshots, blueprints, and CLI/API resources) designed specifically for agent-driven, non-human workflows, with benchmarks docs explicitly describing automated provision-run-score-teardown loops. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of a fully autonomous agent loop (only docs), and no explicit example showing an agent programmatically reading execution results back via API.
